name: Borderlands 4: Deluxe Edition
storyline: The story takes place on Kairos, a planet whose location was revealed to the wider galaxy when Pandora's moon Elpis was teleported across space in an event known as Moonfall. Six years later, a new generation of Vault Hunters arrives on Kairos, drawn by the promise of the fabled Vault and the secret alien treasures it is said to hold. Standing in their way is the Timekeeper, a ruthless dictator who rules the planet with an army of synthetic followers called the Order. Among the arriving Vault Hunters are Rafa the Exo-Soldier, Harlowe the Gravitar, Amon the Forgeknight, and Vex the Siren. Thrust into a world under tyranny, they join forces with the Crimson Resistance to rise up against the Timekeeper and uncover the mysteries buried beneath Kairos.
summary:
Pre-Purchase Borderlands 4 and receive the Gilded Glory Pack featuring a Vault Hunter Skin, a Weapon Skin, and an ECHO-4 Drone Skin!
Take on new areas with unique missions and bosses, earn more rewards with Vault Cards, and collect all kinds of additional loot with the Borderlands 4 Deluxe Edition!

Borderlands 4 Deluxe Edition includes:
• Full base game
• Pre-Purchase Bonus: Gilded Glory Pack*

1 Vault Hunter Skin

1 Weapon Skin

1 ECHO-4 Drone Skin
• Firehawk's Fury Weapon Skin
• Bounty Pack Bundle**

4 unique areas, featuring new missions and unique bosses

4 Vault Cards with unique challenges and rewards

New gear and weapons

New Vault Hunter cosmetics

Borderlands 4 brings intense action, badass Vault Hunters, and billions of wild and deadly weapons to an all-new planet ruled by a ruthless tyrant.
